title: report-feature-status
responsibility: Produces a report-only feature-document status inventory, flagging planned docs with matching complete loops or explicitly verified linked units and identifying missing owner/date evidence.

inputs.name: featureStatusReport.root
inputs.description: Repository root from which featureDocuments and completeLoopsFor read planned and implemented feature documents and loop folders under specification/ and under each packages/<name>/ directory; this operation does not read unit manifests or evidence history. Returned paths are relative to this root, and a missing folder contributes nothing.

inputs.name: featureStatusReport.verifiedUnitIds
inputs.description: Unit IDs the caller has already confirmed as verified; each planned document whose frontmatter unitIds contains one of them is listed in stalePlanned with a verified-units reason. The function only reads this set and checks no evidence itself, so an empty set adds no verified-units reasons.

inputs.name: linkedUnits.root
inputs.description: Repository root whose specification/units directory is scanned recursively for .json files, each parsed as a unit manifest; files that are not valid JSON or whose id or documentation field is not a string are skipped. A missing directory contributes nothing.

inputs.name: verifiedUnitsInHistory.root
inputs.description: Repository root whose refs/heads/harness-evidence ref is queried through Git for passed verification records; when that ref is missing or Git cannot read the root, the result is an empty set rather than an error.

inputs.name: verifiedUnitsInHistory.unitIds
inputs.description: Unit IDs searched for in records/**/record.json files on the evidence ref as a JSON unit key with that exact string value; an empty set returns an empty result without querying Git. A match counts only when the record status is passed and one of its components names the unit, and the result is a warning signal, not shipment proof.

inputs.name: featureDocuments.root
inputs.description: Repository root whose specification/features/planned and specification/features/implemented folders, and the same two folders under each packages/<name>/ directory, supply the direct .md files that are read. Returned paths are relative to this root, and a missing folder contributes no documents.

inputs.name: completeLoopsFor.root
inputs.description: Repository root whose specification/loops folder, and the specification/loops folder under each packages/<name>/ directory, are scanned one level deep for loop directories that contain a loop.json file. Returned loop paths are relative to this root, and a missing folder contributes no loops.

inputs.name: completeLoopsFor.docPath
inputs.description: Feature-document path relative to the root, such as the path field of a featureDocuments entry. A loop directory matches when its name equals the document basename without .md or when the text of its loop.json or trace.ndjson contains this exact path.

inputs.name: filesBelow.directory
inputs.description: Directory whose contents are listed recursively: subdirectories are descended into, while symbolic links are neither listed nor followed. A missing or unreadable directory, at the top level or nested, contributes no files instead of an error.

outputs.name: featureStatusReport
outputs.type: { documents: number; planned: number; implemented: number; classificationMismatches: { path: string; folderStatus: string; frontmatterStatus: string | undefined }[]; stalePlanned: { path: string; reasons: string[] }[]; missingOwnershipOrDateEvidence: { path: string; fields: string[] }[] }
outputs.description: Object holding documents, planned and implemented counts (documents is always planned plus implemented), classificationMismatches where the frontmatter status differs from the folder status, including when no frontmatter status exists, stalePlanned for planned documents with a complete loop or with a frontmatter unit ID the caller marked verified, and missingOwnershipOrDateEvidence for documents whose owner or reviewedAt is null or undefined. These are review signals: nothing is written, and a stale label does not prove that work shipped.

outputs.name: linkedUnits
outputs.description: Map keyed by each unit manifest's raw documentation string, without checking that a feature document exists at that path, to the unit IDs of the manifests that name it in scan order; duplicate IDs from separate manifests are both kept. Manifests that are not valid JSON or whose id or documentation field is not a string contribute nothing.

outputs.name: verifiedUnitsInHistory
outputs.description: Subset of the requested unit IDs that appears as the unit of a component in a passed record on refs/heads/harness-evidence; the set is empty when no IDs are requested, when the ref is missing, or when Git cannot answer. It is a warning signal only and does not establish that any unit shipped.

outputs.name: main
outputs.description: Writes the feature-status JSON for process.cwd() to standard output: the featureStatusReport fields, unitLinks for unit manifests that name a discovered feature document, and a fixed ownershipAndDateEvidence note, without modifying documents. When process.argv includes --check and classificationMismatches is not empty, it also sets process.exitCode to 1.

outputs.name: featureDocuments
outputs.type: Array<{ path: string; status: 'planned' | 'implemented'; metadata: { status: string | undefined; owner: string | null | undefined; reviewedAt: string | null | undefined; unitIds: string[] } }>
outputs.description: One entry for each .md file directly inside a planned or implemented feature folder of the root or of a packages/<name>/ directory, with its root-relative path, its folder status, and the frontmatter status, owner, reviewedAt and unitIds. owner and reviewedAt are undefined when the key is absent, null when written as null, and otherwise the raw text after the colon and spaces (possibly empty); unitIds comes from a JSON array on its unitIds line or else from indented list items, and is empty when neither yields strings.

outputs.name: completeLoopsFor
outputs.description: Root-relative paths of the loop directories that match the document by name or referenced text and whose loop.json has a nonempty steps array in which every step status is complete. Loops with missing, unreadable, invalid or incomplete evidence are omitted instead of reported as errors.

outputs.name: filesBelow
outputs.description: Paths of every regular file found recursively under the directory, each built with path.join from the directory argument and the names below it. Symbolic links and entries inside unreadable or missing directories do not appear.

errors.name: Feature documentation read failure
errors.description: Thrown when readFileSync fails on a planned or implemented feature .md file, for example from a permission error or a file removed after it was listed, because featureDocuments does not catch read failures. Malformed loop, unit and history evidence is caught and skipped, so it never produces this error.
